name: Tanner Buchanan
bio: Tanner Buchanan is an actor, known for Cobra Kai (2018), Designated Survivor (2016), The Fosters (2013) and Grey's Anatomy (2005).

credits.title: Art of Murder
credits.overview: Having done some of the most shocking art the public has ever seen, Sasha is the most sought-after artist in the world. In search of inspiration, she moves to Hong Kong where she meets her most unexpected muse yet, a serial killer.

credits.title: How to Date Billy Walsh
credits.overview: Archie has been in love with his best friend Amelia for as long as he can remember. Just when he builds up the courage to declare his feelings, she falls head over heels for Billy Walsh, a new American transfer student.

credits.title: The Hyperions
credits.overview: In 1960, Professor Ruckus Mandulbaum invented the Titan badge - a device that enables humans to have a particular super power. credits.title: Sinister Seduction
credits.overview: A recent widow is glad when her son finds a new friend, but it soon becomes clear that he's after a different type of companionship.

credits.title: He's All That
credits.overview: To get revenge on her ex-boyfriend, an influencer attempts to transform an unpopular classmate into prom king.

credits.title: Max Winslow and The House of Secrets
credits.overview: Five teenagers compete to win a mansion owned by entrepreneur and scientist Atticus Virtue. To win the teens must face-off against a super computer named HAVEN who controls the mansion.

credits.title: Chance
credits.overview: A true story of a teenage love triangle leading to one of the two boys' tragic death - told through the lens of elite youth baseball.

credits.title: Anything
credits.overview: After the death of his wife, a man moves from Mississippi to a run-down Hollywood apartment, where he meets someone new.

credits.title: The Heyday of the Insensitive Bastards
credits.overview: Seven vignettes explore the difference between fantasy and reality, memory and history, and the joy and agony of the human condition.

credits.title: Guests
credits.overview: When Charlie and his family move to a warmer climate for the sake of his father's illness, he finds himself teetering between battles of the thought of losing his father with a conflict he has with a ferocious bully at school.

credits.title: Jake Squared
credits.overview: A filmmaker sets out to make a new project in order to figure out how he's screwed up every relationship he's ever had.

credits.title: The Real St. Nick
credits.overview: A pretty psychiatrist is saved from an accident by a man who, after hitting his head on a rock, believes he is Santa Claus. As she nurses him back to health at her institute, he brings the spirit of Christmas to the hospital.
